HSE Officer Job at  La'Voil Engineering Limited




        
    

        
        Founded in 2016, La'Voil Engineering Limited is a fully indigenous Nigerian company offering specialized services in the Oil & Gas, Energy, Civil Construction, and Facility Management sectors. Strategically located in Ekpan-Effurun, Delta State, the heart of Nigeria's oil-rich Niger Delta region, we are well-positioned to deliver value-driven engineering solutions that support upstream, midstream, and downstream operations. 
     

            
    



At La'Voil Engineering, we blend technical expertise, local content development, and world-class safety practices to deliver projects that meet and exceed client expectations. With a team of experienced professionals, state-of-the-art equipment, and a passion for innovation, we've built a reputation for excellence, reliability, and timely delivery.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HSE Officer

Job Location: Warri, Delta

Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess relevant qualification and experience.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candiates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
